title: Cupboard and Balloons
statementMd:
A girl named Xenia has a cupboard that looks like an arc from ahead. The arc is made of a semicircle with radius $*r*$ (the cupboard's top) and two walls of height $*h*$ (the cupboard's sides). The cupboard's depth is $*r*$, that is, it looks like a rectangle with base $*r*$ and height $*h* + *r*$ from the sides. The figure below shows what the cupboard looks like (the front view is on the left, the side view is on the right).

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a0859d707114926c37a2a1fec2a9d1e5df510e60.png)

Xenia got lots of balloons for her birthday. The girl hates the mess, so she wants to store the balloons in the cupboard. Luckily, each balloon is a sphere with radius ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a4fcadf5554db1a524f8d91fc4f6fb6d9fa61718.png). Help Xenia calculate the maximum number of balloons she can put in her cupboard.

You can say that a balloon is in the cupboard if you can't see any part of the balloon on the left or right view. The balloons in the cupboard can touch each other. It is not allowed to squeeze the balloons or deform them in any way. You can assume that the cupboard's walls are negligibly thin.

## Input

The single line contains two integers $*r*, *h*$ $(1 ≤ *r*, *h* ≤ 10^{7})$.

## Output

Print a single integer — the maximum number of balloons Xenia can put in the cupboard.
statementZhMd:
一名叫 Xenia 的女孩有一个从正面看起来像拱形的柜子。这个拱形由一个半径为 $*r*$ 的半圆（柜子的顶部）和两面高度为 $*h*$ 的墙（柜子的两侧）组成。柜子的深度为 $*r*$，也就是说，从侧面看，它是一个底边为 $*r*$、高为 $*h* + *r*$ 的矩形。下图展示了柜子的样子（左侧为正视图，右侧为侧视图）。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a0859d707114926c37a2a1fec2a9d1e5df510e60.png)

Xenia 生日时收到了很多气球。女孩讨厌杂乱，因此她想把气球存放在柜子里。幸运的是，每个气球都是半径为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a4fcadf5554db1a524f8d91fc4f6fb6d9fa61718.png) 的球体。请帮助 Xenia 计算她最多可以在柜子里放入多少个气球。

如果从左视图或右视图中都看不到气球的任何部分，就可以认为气球在柜子里。柜子里的气球可以彼此接触。不允许挤压或以任何方式使气球变形。可以认为柜子的墙壁厚度可以忽略不计。

## 输入格式

一行包含两个整数 $*r*, *h*$ $(1 ≤ *r*, *h* ≤ 10^{7})$。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——Xenia 最多可以在柜子里放入的气球数量。
